item.title: Vulnify: Giving Your Agents a CVE Brain
item.description: <p>The CVE brain your AI agent has been missing. In this blog, we introduce Vulnify, an open-source tool that stitches eight authoritative vulnerability databases into a single offline source of truth for CVE intelligence.</p>

item.title: Pandora’s Container Part 1: Unpacking Azure Container Security
item.description: <p>Azure container services are everywhere. Their attack surface? Often overlooked. In Part 1 of this blog series, we walk through offensive techniques targeting registries, token keys, and container instances in Azure.</p>

item.title: CMMC is (Not) Cancelled
item.description: <p>Just because CMMC Phase II audits are paused doesn't mean compliance is. In this blog, we clarify what the suspension means for defense contractors and why self-assessments and core regulations remain in effect.</p>

item.title: The New Hotness in Phishing: Device Code Attacks in M365
item.description: <p>Device code phishing is quietly becoming one of the more effective techniques targeting M365 environments. In this blog, we detail how it works and the Conditional Access controls that shut it down.</p>

item.title: CCPA Update: Who’s In Scope (Part 1)
item.description: <p>California updated CCPA... again. Before you do anything else, does it apply to you? In Part 1 of this blog series, we clarify who falls under scope, what data is covered, and how enforcement works.</p>

item.title: CCPA Update: Cybersecurity Requirements (Part 2)
item.description: <p>Confirmed you're in scope for CCPA? Now comes the cybersecurity audit requirement. In Part 2 of this blog series, we cover what it entails, the phased timeline, and the penalties for non-compliance.</p>

item.title: AI Directives and AI Strategy Development
item.description: <p>The hardest part of AI adoption isn't the tech, it's the strategy. In this blog, we outline a practical framework covering governance, risk classification, threat modeling, and monitoring before the tools ever go live.</p>

item.title: TLS Encryption and Compliance
item.description: <p>Transport Layer Security: the compliance checkbox that's harder to get right than it looks. In this blog, we cover the most common TLS misconfigurations and what organizations need to know to meet the standard.</p>

item.title: The Art of Hunting Azure Cloud Secrets
item.description: <p>The difference between a standard cloud test and a subscription takeover? Finding the right secrets. In this blog, we introduce two open-source tools for hunting Azure secrets that probably shouldn't be there.</p>

item.title: A Vault With No Treasure - CMMC Level 2 Compliance for Subcontractors With No CUI
